claims.subject: flow_004_launch_i_LsuDriveToLunch_1
claims.explanation: The flow starts at i_LsuDriveToLunch_1, passes through a delay (lsuDelay0), merges with another LSU path (lsuMerge), then splits into two parallel WaitMerge paths (rele0Merge and rele4Merge). Each WaitMerge path feeds a SelSplit selector (rele0Selector, rele4Selector) that routes to either a delay loop or to rs1Merge/rs2Merge. The merged rs1/rs2 paths combine at regMerge, then split at launchSplitter into three branches: one to exeMerge2 (via delays and fifos), one to regSplitter (which further splits to grfSrfSele and releSplitter), and one to regSelector. The final outputs are o_launchDriveToGrf_1, o_launchDriveToSrf_1 (from grfSrfSele), and o_launchDriveToExe_1 (from exeMerge2).

claims.subject: lsuMerge

claims.subject: rele0Merge and rele4Merge

claims.explanation: Each selector (cSelector2_33b_launch) takes an input from its corresponding WaitMerge and a delayed feedback signal. It outputs to either a delay loop (for internal reuse) or to the rs1/rs2 merge network. This allows events to be held or forwarded based on availability.

claims.subject: rs1Merge and rs2Merge

claims.subject: regMerge
